pob.text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah[a], the son of David[b], the son of Abraham.

spob.text: The book of the family line[a] of Jesus the Messiah[b], the son of David, the son of Abraham.

public_domain_references.bsb: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
public_domain_references.web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
public_domain_references.asv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
public_domain_references.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

pob.text: Abraham fathered Isaac[a], and Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers,

spob.text: Abraham fathered Isaac, Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.

public_domain_references.bsb: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
public_domain_references.web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
public_domain_references.asv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;
public_domain_references.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

pob.text: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar[a], Perez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered Aram.

spob.text: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered Aram.[a]

spob.text: Aram was Amminadab’s father; Amminadab was Nahshon’s father; and Nahshon was Salmon’s father.[a]

pob.text: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab[a], and Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth, and Obed fathered Jesse,

spob.text: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab. Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth. And Obed fathered Jesse.

pob.text: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh[a], Manasseh fathered Amos, and Amos fathered Josiah.

spob.text: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh[a], Manasseh fathered Amos, and Amos fathered Josiah.

pob.text: Josiah fathered Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the deportation to Babylon[a].

spob.text: Josiah fathered Jeconiah and his brothers at the time people were forcibly taken to Babylon[a].

public_domain_references.bsb: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

spob.text: After the people were taken into exile in Babylon, Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel, and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.

pob.text: Zerubbabel fathered Abiud[a], Abiud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor.

spob.text: Zerubbabel fathered Abiud[a], Abiud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

pob.text: Azor fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Achim, and Achim fathered Eliud.

spob.text: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Achim, and Achim was the father of Eliud.

public_domain_references.bsb: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

pob.text: Eliud fathered Eleazar, and Eleazar fathered Matthan, and Matthan fathered Jacob.

spob.text: Eliud fathered Eleazar. Eleazar fathered Matthan. Matthan fathered Jacob.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

pob.text: And Jacob fathered Joseph[a], the husband of Mary, from whom Jesus was born[b], who is called the Messiah.

spob.text: And Jacob fathered Joseph, the husband of Mary. Jesus, who is called the Messiah[a], was born from Mary.

public_domain_references.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

pob.text: So all the generations from Abraham to David were fourteen generations[a], and from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations[b], and from the exile to Babylon to the Messiah fourteen generations.

spob.text: So from Abraham to David there were fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the exile to Babylon to the Messiah, fourteen generations.

public_domain_references.bsb: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.

pob.text: The birth of Jesus the Messiah happened in this way: when his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph[a], before they came together[c][b], she was found to be pregnant from the Holy Spirit.

spob.text: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah happened: His mother Mary was formally promised in marriage to Joseph.[a] Before they came together,[b] she was found to be pregnant from the Holy Spirit.

public_domain_references.bsb: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.asv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

pob.text: And Joseph[a], her husband, being a righteous man and not wanting to expose her to public disgrace[c][b], intended to divorce her quietly.

spob.text: Joseph, her husband, was a righteous man, and he did not want to disgrace her publicly. So he intended to divorce her quietly.

public_domain_references.bsb: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
public_domain_references.web: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
public_domain_references.asv: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just [man], and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

pob.text: But as he was considering these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife, for what has been conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.”

spob.text: While he was thinking about this, suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife[a], for what has been conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.”

public_domain_references.bsb: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.web: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.asv: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

pob.text: She will bear a son[a], and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.

spob.text: She will give birth to a son, and you are to name him Jesus.[a] He himself will save his people from their sins.

public_domain_references.bsb: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”

public_domain_references.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

pob.text: All this happened so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet might be fulfilled[a], saying,
